claim_limits: The independent energy scans are a physics-constrained stress test, not dense-manual-ground-truth accuracy.
Coverage and post-gap recovery must be presented before the conditional pair-distance residual.
Geometry-inconsistent accepted fits indicate possible false continuity, not externally proven identity switches.
The EasyLEED-ViPErLEED inset uses a separate initialization contract and denominator and is not a sixth row in the main method matrix.
question: How do tracking strategies differ under radial motion and true I(V) visibility gaps?

representative_case.selection_rule: Order frozen cases by scientific series and pair identity; select the first case that passed the predeclared coherent-pairwise-energy-law check and contains at least one natural I(V) visibility gap. Do not inspect method outcomes.
